package.name: navrl_nodes
package.description: Thin ROS 2 wrappers (plan D8) around the sim-agnostic MPC+CBF core package: mpc_node (10 Hz NMPC), cbf_node (10 Hz safety filter), human_tracker_node (abstracted ground-truth tracker). All control logic lives in the ROS-free `core` Python package; these nodes only move messages.
